{{Infobox auto}}
'''Fish bones''' are a [[fishing junk]] item. They are a {{MCW|Bone|bone}} with a different name and texture, so they work anywhere a bone does, for example crafting [[Bone Meal|bone meal]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
* The junk table lists them at 10 of 78 weight in most biomes (12.82% of junk, about 1.28% of all catches). These come from the loot table <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>, which builds them on an {{MCW|Ender Pearl|ender pearl}} instead of a bone (see [[#Junk fish bones]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref>
* 90.91% of the Sulfur Caves table, 41.77% of catches in Sulfur Caves. These are real bones.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>

Catching bone-based fish bones plays their own [[fishing sounds|sound]].

=== Junk fish bones ===
Fish bones caught as junk look and are named the same as the others, but they are ender pearls: they can be thrown to teleport, stack to 16, don't stack with the fish bones from Sulfur Caves and can't be used as a bone. Their catch plays no sound, and they don't unlock the Fish Bones entry of the [[Angler's Almanac]], which checks for a bone. This is a bug (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/anglers_almanac/junk/fish_bones.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Fish bones from Sulfur Caves now have the correct texture, so they stack with fish bones from the junk table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.4|Junk fish bones come from their own loot table, <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>. That table gives an {{MCW|Ender Pearl|ender pearl}} with the fish bones name and model instead of a bone (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref> The junk table couldn't be loaded, so they could only be caught in Sulfur Caves.}}
{{History line|1.12.5|The junk table loads again, so fish bones can be caught as junk, as ender pearls.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Fishing Junk LT Fixed (Not for modded biomes)}}</ref>}}
}}
